scenario: LUNI.8.4 — `%` (modulo) requires same-dim operands. `r.dist % 5_kg` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_DIM_MISMATCH (length % mass). Follows the same gate as `+` and `-`.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    dist: meter key

rule bad:
    R r where (r.dist % 5_kilogram) > 1
->
    log info "never"
